primary_title: Cytokine-Like Factor 1, an Essential Facilitator of Cardiotrophin-Like Cytokine:Ciliary Neurotrophic Factor Receptor α Signaling and sorLA-Mediated Turnover
decision_basis: The reviews identify CLC:CLF-1 as a heterodimeric cytokine and cite primary evidence for CNTFRα/gp130/LIFR signaling and CLF-1-dependent SorLA association/internalization of the tripartite complex.
limitations_preserved: Preserve CLC:CLF-1 heterodimer, CLF-1-mediated SorLA association, tripartite CNTFRα context and endocytic turnover; no standalone CLCF1, productive SorLA kinase relay, SCI or terminal-TF inference.
